result.summary: Consolidates individual BSD build documentation into doc/build-unix.md and reworks the memory limits section. It removes redundant boilerplate CMake commands across separate BSD files, leaving OS-specific package installation instructions integrated directly into the general Unix build guide.
result.problem: Maintaining separate BSD build documents creates duplicated boilerplate CMake commands and dependency instructions. Changes to build documentation require updating multiple redundant files.
evidence: Author note in description: 'They all include the same redundant boilerplate cmake commands and doc snippets. So updating the build system requires identical changes over many files.'
result.scope_notes: Deletes several BSD-specific markdown files and updates build-unix.md; author suggests reviewing commit fa58b10b17 with '--color-moved=dimmed-zebra'.
result.card: Merges separate BSD build documentation back into build-unix.md and restructures the memory limits guidance. This eliminates repetitive CMake boilerplate and duplicate instructions across multiple BSD docs that currently make documentation updates tedious. Evidence rests on developer maintenance convenience stated in the PR description, with no external issue linked. There are no dependencies.

risk.why: Incorrect documentation changes could confuse users attempting to compile on BSD platforms.
